summary: Roan Mountain SP campground confirmed open in part: 36 RV sites (1-18, 39-56; 50 A + water, no sewer, back-in to 64 ft) + 20 tent sites bookable; upper loop 58-106 closed since Helene (bridge). $40-62 (stored $44-50); year-round with one winter bathhouse; showers, dump, wifi, seasonal store. WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE CANDIDATE: riverfront -> not waterfront (river under canopy, no site photo shows water, narrow mountain river = creekside by size). Phone '' -> 423-547-3900.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE CANDIDATE riverfront -> not waterfront (default down). The stored value rests on 'riverside' prose and was deferred under canopy. (1) Size: the Doe River here is a mountain stream that the park map draws as a thin line, well under ~30 m, so it can be creekside at most, never riverfront. (2) Proximity: the campground map draws the lower loop's west row against the river: RV sites 39, 40, 41, 44, 46, 48, 50, 52, 54 and 56 (~36.160-36.162,-82.100 area; sold nightly at $40-62, 25-64 ft) plus tent sites 31-38. But no engine photo of those sites shows water, including a leaf-off photo of 50, which shows ~15-20 m of lawn behind the pad and then a wooded/rhododendron bank. Esri is a low-resolution tile with the campground and river fully under canopy, so no distance can be measured. CREEKSIDE LEAD: a ground check of 39-41/50 against the walk-down rule (Caledonia precedent) could earn creekside.

STATUS: the upper campground (sites 58-106, 30 A) has been closed since Hurricane Helene ('significant damage to the bridge leading to the campsites ... TDOT is currently developing a plan to rebuild the bridge'). The lower RV sites 1-18 and 39-56 are open and bookable in every window read, Nov 2026 - Oct 2027.
